name: Mugga Lane landfill
notes: Opened in the 1970s; about 1 Mt/yr received with ~70% recovered, so ~300 kt/yr landfilled. Existing 4.24 MW gas-to-energy plant makes ~37,000 MWh/yr, which this model implies is ~40% of generated methane. PROXY: constant 300 kt/yr since 1975 and closure in 2035 are assumptions; k and L0 are screening defaults. Coordinates approximate.
sources: ACT City Services, Mugga Lane Gas-to-Energy factsheet (Aug 2025): https://www.cityservices.act.gov.au/__data/assets/pdf_file/0003/1653393/Mugga-Lane-Gas-to-Energy-factsheet-August2025-acc.pdf
ABC News, 20 Nov 2023, landfill gas expansion (~300,000 t/yr to ACT landfills): https://www.abc.net.au/news/2023-11-20/energy-generated-from-landfill-gas-to-power-canberra-homes/103124726

name: Lucas Heights landfill
notes: 890,134 t received in 2024 (approved up to 970,000 t/yr); waste receipt must cease at the end of 2037. Landfill gas already collected and converted to electricity by Energy Developments. PROXY: opening year 1987, tonnage before 2024 and 50% existing capture are assumptions to verify. Coordinates approximate.
sources: Cleanaway, Lucas Heights Landfill Annual Environmental Management Report 2024 (SSD-6835): https://cleanaway2stor.blob.core.windows.net/cleanaway2-blob-container/2025/03/AEMR-SSD-6835-2024-Lucas-Heights-Landfill.pdf

name: Melbourne Regional Landfill, Ravenhall
notes: Cleanaway's largest site, over 200 ha, processing over 2 Mt/yr; landfill gas is already used for electricity or renewable gas. PROXY: 2 Mt/yr since 2004, closure in 2040 and 50% existing capture are assumptions; not all tonnage processed is necessarily landfilled. Coordinates approximate.
sources: Cleanaway, Ravenhall (Melbourne Regional Landfill) site page: https://www.cleanaway.com.au/location/ravenhall
